'''Vorn Tel-Ovis''' was an elderly and ornery [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who [[Junk dealer/Legends|operated]] a [[Vorn's junk shop|junk shop]] in [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Trex]] became in need of a replacement [[hypermatter reactor igniter]] for [[Krayt Fang|his starship]], Tel-Ovis made a deal to sell him one. Soon afterward, group of individuals on the run from the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]], sought to obtain the one that Tel-Ovis promised for Trex in order to take the bounty hunter's [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter]] for themselves to get off-[[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="EotE" />
